Create 2 Instances – 1. AnsibleController, 2. AnsibleNode
Connect to AnsibleNode:
sudo apt-get update
sudo python3 --version(ensure you get python version)
sudo passwd ubuntu (give password as ubuntu)
sudo vim /etc/ssh/sshd_config 
It will open a file, press Esc-I, then search for PasswordAuthentication, remove the # so that it is uncommented. Press Esc:wq to save and quit.
sudo service ssh restart

Connect to AnsibleController:
sudo apt-get update
sudo python3 –version
ssh-keygen –t rsa –b 4096
press enter 3 times
Check where the public key is saved
sudo cat /home/ubuntu/.ssh/id_rsa.pub
ssh-rsa  ubuntu@ip-172-31-44-54
Connect to AnsibleNode
sudo vim .ssh/authorized_keys
Goto insert mode and Copy paste the above key in the first line as below:
Connect to controller machine
ssh -v ubuntu@AnsibleNode-ipaddress
Ensure there is no error
sudo apt-get install software-properties-common
sudo apt-add-repository ppa:ansible/ansible
sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install -y ansible
cd /etc/ansible
ls
sudo vim hosts
Copy the Ip-address of the AnsibleNode and paste in hosts file

Run the below commands from controller:
1.	Find out the freespace in the managing nodes
ansible all -i /etc/ansible/hosts -m command -a 'free'
2.	create files in server1 and 2 from controller
ansible all -i/etc/ansible/hosts -m command -a 'touch f1 f2 f3'
To check the files created run the below:
ssh 172.31.5.200
ls
3.	Install git in all server
ansible all -m apt -a 'name=git state=present' -b
4.	Install tomcat
ansible all -m apt -a 'name=tomcat10 state=present update_cache=yes' -b
